reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, round-2 fix-verification batch

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Competency is 'Compare two numbers up to 20', but all 5 rendered operand pairs (3/1, 3/1, 1/1, 1/3, 1/2) never use a number above 3, far short of the stated range.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Seeds 42 and 43 render the byte-identical question 'Which is greater: 3 or 1?' with the same answer, showing no variety was actually exercised between those two seeds.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The 'Which is greater: X or Y?' template is short and clear, appropriate for Grade 1 Q1 reading level.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The equal case (1 vs 1 -> '=') and both orderings (1 vs 3 -> '<', 3 vs 1 -> '>') are represented, showing the three comparison symbols are all reachable.

competency_alignment.rationale: Each sample correctly asks the student to identify greater/lesser/equal between two numbers, matching the number_comparison concept.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Operands used are only 1, 2 and 3 across the entire batch; a competency scoped to 'up to 20' should exercise numbers much closer to that ceiling, e.g. comparing 17 and 12.
